data_fields.name: timeout_auto_choose
data_fields.donor_constant: false by default; format rule turns on

best_idea: Give each coach a per-bout command bank that refills a fixed amount each round up to a cap, with a per-command cap and a disconnect clock, and resolve an empty bank with a server-side default rather than a free pass.
decision_why: The bank, per-command cap and round refill fit a coach command budget, but the donor forfeits a disconnected player and its default (first move, roster order) is weak; its DC-bank rule is wired to the wrong key and its drain is per tick, not measured time, so we keep the shape, replace the forfeit with a default-fill, and fix the defects.
acceptance: A coach with a 210 s bank, 10 s refill per round and a 150 s per-command cap issues commands; each round adds 10 s up to the cap; with the bank empty the next command is the coach's saved default and a fight-log row records it; a disconnected coach's clock ends at 60 s and the default is applied, not a forfeit.
